name: bastion-memory-skills
description: CockroachDB-backed memory skills for AI agents. Provides persistent, tamper-proof memory with hash-chain integrity, C-SPANN vector indexing, and time-travel queries.
author: Bastion

skills.name: Memory Store
skills.description: Store memories with SHA-256 hash chain integrity and C-SPANN vector indexing.

skills.name: Memory Search
skills.description: Semantic vector search across agent memories with cognitive decay weighting.

output_schema.results: array of MemoryRecord objects with similarity scores

skills.name: Memory Time Travel
skills.description: Query memory state as it existed at a past timestamp using CockroachDB AS OF SYSTEM TIME.

input_schema.timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp or relative string like '5 minutes ago'

output_schema.memories: array of MemoryRecord objects as they existed at the timestamp

skills.name: Memory Audit
skills.description: Verify hash chain integrity and detect tampering in agent memory.

output_schema.broken_links: array of audit entries with integrity issues

skills.name: Memory Self-Heal
skills.description: Detect and repair memory corruption using hash chain verification and S3 snapshots.

skills.name: Knowledge Graph Query
skills.description: Traverse the knowledge graph with multi-hop BFS starting from an entity.

skills.name: Conflict Resolution
skills.description: Resolve conflicting memories using semantic comparison and CRDT merge strategies.

skills.name: A2A Bridge
skills.description: Generate a signed A2A Agent Card for cross-agent communication.
